chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad from Sahl ibn Ziyad, raising it, said:

He (peace be upon him) said: When you pray on the day of Friday, say: O Allah! Send Blessings upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad, the Successors, the Pleased with, with the most superior of Your Blessings, and Bless upon them with the most superior of Your Blessings, and the greetings be upon him and upon them, and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings.

For whoever says it at the end of Al-Asr prayer, Allah will write for him one hundred thousand good deeds, erase from him one hundred thousand sins, fulfill for him one hundred thousand needs through it, and raise for him one hundred thousand levels.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting this specific supplication after Friday prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi*, this hadith emphasizes the specific virtue of reciting this invocation after the Asr prayer on Fridays, highlighting the Shia emphasis on the 'Ahl al-Bayt' as the 'Al-Wasiyyun' (the Successors/Inheritors of knowledge). The promise of a hundred thousand good deeds and needs being fulfilled underscores the spiritual potency of connecting with the Prophet's lineage through this specific devotional act. This practice reflects the broader Shia tradition of linking daily worship with the intercession and spiritual authority of the Imams.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, raising it, said,

‘Heasws said: ‘When you pray Salāt of the day of Friday, so say, ‘O Allahazwj! Send Blessings upon Muhammadsaww and the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww, the succesorsasws, the ones Pleased with, with the most superior of Yourazwj Blessings, and Bless upon them with the most superior of Yourazwj Blessings, and the greetings be upon himsaww and upon themasws, and the Mercy of Allahazwj and Hisazwj Blessings’.

So the one who says it at the end of Al-Asr (Salāt), Allahazwj would Write a hundred thousand good deeds for him and Delete a hundred thousand sins from him, and Fulfil a hundred thousand needs for him due to it, and Raise a hundred thousand Levels for him’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad in a marfu‘ manner (from the Imam) who has said the following: “

After completing Friday Salah (prayer) say, ‘Allahumma Salli ‘Ala Muhammad wa ‘Ali Muhammad. . . (O Allah grant Muhammad and his family a compensation worthy of their serving Your cause, the well accepted executors of his will, with most preferred compensations and grant them blessings of the best form of your blessings, he and they all are ‘Alayhim al-Salam, mercy and blessings).’

Whoever says this after the afternoon Salah (prayer), Allah writes for him one hundred thousand good deeds, deletes his one hundred thousand bad deeds, makes his one hundred thousand wishes come true and raises his position by one hundred thousand degrees.’”
